604:t_1:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I've been thinking about it all this time. About why that idiot... $$カルロス$$ wanted to change the world...」

604:t_1:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「He wanted to destroy a world dominated by $$クロノ$$, didn't he?」

604:t_1:6.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...Just before he graduated from university, I told him about $$クロノ$$, the watchers of humanity's evolution, and about the $$アクシオン$$ family that bears the destiny of its $$キング$$.」

604:t_1:7.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「He said he'd do as he pleased until that day came, turned $$アクシオン$$ into a foundation, and built it up into the world's top corporate group.」

604:t_1:8.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「To fight me... and $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's because $$カルロス$$ was like that that $$エルガン・ローディック$$ entrusted him with the $$スフィア$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$, isn't it?」

604:t_1:10.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...What do you intend to do from here on?」

604:t_1:12.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「I have practically no real power left. Even before that, you could say $$クロノ$$ no longer has any meaning in this world.」

604:t_1:13.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Even if you learn who its members are at this point, there is nothing you can do.」

604:t_1:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「I know that perfectly well.」

604:t_1:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I don't think there's nothing left for me to do.」

604:t_1:16.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Are you saying you will carry on my son's will?」

604:t_1:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have no such obligation.」

604:t_1:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「But as it turns out, we are going to head toward the place he was aiming for, too.」

604:t_1:19.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Once the $$ラプラスの箱$$ of the $$宇宙世紀$$ is opened, the doctrine of $$クロノ$$ will inevitably come to light as well.」

604:t_1:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「Whatever it turns out to be, it won't stop. Not $c... and not me...」

604:t_1:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have no intention of listening to anything you say.」

604:t_1:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Shall we be going soon, $$トライア$$? Everyone is assembled.」

604:t_1:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I asked them to come along, but they declined. It seems they intend to go up to space alone.」

604:t_1:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's fine. Then let's go.」

604:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「Farewell, naked king. You're an old man left behind by the times, so enjoy the rest of your life in a corner of the world.」

604:t_1:30.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...An old man left behind... is that so...」

604:t_1:31.en:
$$グエン$$
「She's a harsh one, isn't she?」

604:t_1:32.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Was it you who told them of the $$キング$$'s existence, $$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$?」

604:t_1:33.en:
$$グエン$$
「From the way you put that, it seems you also know I was cooperating with the anti-Empire forces.」

604:t_1:35.en:
$$グエン$$
「But the answer to your earlier question is no. All I did was tell them that you were here.」

604:t_1:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「Will you purge me, the traitor?」

604:t_1:38.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...This old man has no such energy left.」

604:t_1:39.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Ever since the day I lost my son, part of me may have been waiting somewhere for this day to come...」

604:t_1:40.en:
$$グエン$$
「Is that also why you welcomed me into $$クロノ$$?」

604:t_1:41.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「I saw youth in you... and I bet on your ambition.」

604:t_1:42.en:
$$グエン$$
「You overestimate me. I have nothing of my own, so I'm merely a man who makes use of other people's strength.」

604:t_1:43.en:
$$グエン$$
「If I was able to contribute in any way to reaching this day, it would be because I had the power to believe.」

604:t_1:44.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「To believe that there is something beyond the future of despair written in the final chapter of 《$$メトロポリス$$》...?」

604:t_1:45.en:
$$グエン$$
「No... It's the power of believing in $$ローラ$$ and his companions, and in $c.」

604:t_1:46.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...I wonder if they can really win...」

604:t_1:48.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Time begins to move... The time that had stopped since that day when humanity set foot on the Moon...」

604:t_1:49.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「That is the beginning of humanity's true battle...」

604:t_1:53.en: ～ $$シャイアン基地$$ Underground: Colony Laser Control Room ～

604:t_1:55.en:
$$ローナン$$
「The $$コロニーレーザー$$ is ready to fire. All that remains is to approve its execution.」

604:t_1:56.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$c will take care of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and we'll take care of $c...」

604:t_1:57.en:
$$ローナン$$
「And then $$サイアム・ビスト$$, who knows the further truth at the very bottom of $$ラプラスの箱$$, will die as well...」

604:t_1:58.en:
$$ローナン$$
「With this, the doctrine of $$クロノ$$ will be protected. The safety of Earth's humanity should be guaranteed too.」

604:t_1:59.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Earth's humanity? Don't you mean the chosen humans?」

604:t_1:60.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...I won't deny it. But that is the limit of humanity as a species.」

604:t_1:61.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Sacrificing the many to keep the few alive... That's the reverse of what $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ used to say so often.」

604:t_1:63.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It can't be helped. It's what the times demanded.」

604:t_1:64.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Then I hereby approve the firing of the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

604:t_1:65.en:
$$マーサ$$
「So in a few minutes, $c will vanish along with $$メガラニカ$$.」

604:t_1:66.en:
$$ローナン$$
「With this, the secret of the Box... the doctrine of $$クロノ$$ will be protected.」

604:t_1:68.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It's no use saying anything, $$アルベルト$$. The firing of the $$コロニーレーザー$$ has been approved... It can't be stopped anymore.」

604:t_1:69.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Aunt $$マーサ$$! How could you, of all people...!」

604:t_1:70.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Forcing people into submission with power...! Isn't that just a man's logic!」

604:t_1:72.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You, who kept denying a man's logic...! In the end, this is your way?!」

604:t_1:73.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Let go, $$アルベルト$$. What right do you have, exactly?」

604:t_1:74.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is there!」

604:t_1:76.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I felt it clearly! Your son... $$リディ・マーセナス$$ is in $$インダストリアル７$$!!」

604:t_1:78.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「He's the $$バンシィ$$'s pilot!!」

604:t_2:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...I carry the blood of the $$ザビ家$$, who led the $$ジオン公国$$ that once existed in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ $$宇宙世紀$$ world.」

604:t_2:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But what I am about to tell you has nothing to do with my origins.」

604:t_2:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have learned a certain secret concerning the very foundation of the $$連邦政府$$. It does not necessarily concern only the $$宇宙世紀$$ world.」

604:t_2:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As one person living in this world, I intend to share that secret with all of you.」

604:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The beginning of the $$宇宙世紀$$... was the beginning of an age in which humanity made space its place to live.」

604:t_2:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that the $$地球連邦$$ government of the time issued was the foundation of that government... and the keystone of its policy decisions.」

kept_omissions: 604:t_1:25 / 604:t_1:26: Traia's あいつ and AG's answer (a companion who declines to come and goes to space alone): the scene does not name them, so kept gender-neutral (that one / they).
604:t_1:30: Axion's musing has no subject (kept impersonal).
604:t_1:73: 手を放せ has no object (what Alberto is gripping); kept 'Let go'.
604:t_1:63: Martha's 時代がそうさせた kept as 'the times demanded' (no explicit object).
uncertain: 604:t_1:24: AG's トライア様 rendered as plain 'Traia' (honorific dropped per rule); AG otherwise speaks very formally.

604:t_1:3-9: Traia's bare カルロス = $$カルロス$$ (Axion's dead son). But dlg_2085_04 has Traia addressing the old man himself as $$カルロス・アクシオン$$; here the old man is Carlos's father, so the source may have a naming clash.
604:t_1:25: referent of あいつ unresolved even with neighbours (Guin stays with Axion, so not Guin).
604:t_1:29: 裸の王様 = 'naked king' (pun on the Emperor's New Clothes plus the King of Chrono).
604:t_1:61: 小を生かすために大を = 'Sacrificing the many to keep the few alive'; assumed Cardeas' usual saying is the reverse (sacrifice the few for the many).
604:t_1:45: ローラ is male per glossary ('his companions').
604:t_1:44: 《メトロポリス》 link kept as a book title ('final chapter of ...').
